lateral_torso_line_topology.vertical_line_count_and_spacing: Approximately 11 distinct vertical white stripes of varying lengths. Spacing is widest at the posterior haunch (approx. 10% of torso width) and becomes more compressed as lines move anteriorly toward the shoulder.
lateral_torso_line_topology.discontinuity_mapping: The three most posterior lines terminate mid-flank; the eighth and ninth lines from the posterior are broken into segments; a singular abbreviated stripe segment exists near the upper shoulder.

posterior_constellation_clusters.spatial_cluster_density: A cluster of 4-5 high-contrast white spots is visible on the posterior haunch, situated inferior to the primary vertical line sequence.

other_distinctive_markers: Two distinct white spots are located on the lateral facial plane below the eye; a prominent white horizontal band is visible on the lower neck/throat region.
